text:
Situation: Leucovorin calcium has been on FDA's drug shortage list since 2012-01-01 and remains listed as of 2026-10-21, a duration of 178 months. Current inventory across our three sites provides 20 to 24 days on hand at present usage rates. Several leucovorin presentations at Corvale East show critically low days on hand, including the 350 mg/7.5 mL vial at 2.9 days and the 50 mg/5 mL vial at 2.7 days.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage posting date is 2012-01-01. A labeled manufacturer, Hospira, Inc. (FEI 1021343), received an OAI classification on 2011-08-04 (150 days before posting), with prior OAI inspections on 2010-01-19 and 2011-06-17 and a Warning Letter on 2010-04-12. Another labeled manufacturer, West-Ward Columbus Inc. (FEI 1510690), received a Warning Letter on 2009-03-30 and a VAI inspection on 2011-01-20.

Our position: Supply is critically constrained for multiple leucovorin presentations. Alternate manufacturers are not on FDA's current shortage list, but their labels do not name plants we can verify. No clinical substitutions are proposed; therapeutic decisions remain with treating clinicians and the committee.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to initiate purchase agreements with American Health Packaging, Epic Pharma LLC, Ingenus Pharmaceuticals LLC, Leading Pharma LLC, and Major Pharmaceuticals, pending P&T committee approval of formulary addition.
2. Buyer to request plant identification and inspection history from each alternate manufacturer, pending Quality Assurance review and approval.
3. Buyer to allocate existing stock to highest-priority protocols, pending Pharmacy Director approval.
4. Buyer to report weekly inventory status to Pharmacy Director and P&T committee chair until supply stabilizes.

Not recommended: Delaying procurement while awaiting plant verification from alternate manufacturers; single-sourcing from any one alternate without confirmed supply continuity.
